services.name: Group Sail
services.desc: From your first day on the water to bluewater cruising, our ASA-certified courses take you step by step. Train locally on Lake Grapevine or aboard in the Caribbean, with US Coast Guard licensed instructors. Each course builds on the one before it, from your first keelboat lesson to skippering a cruising catamaran. Learn to skipper a 20-27′ sloop-rigged keelboat by day in light to moderate winds. Basic terminology, sail trim, points of sail, seamanship, and operating safely. Skipper a sloop-rigged auxiliary 25-35′ keelboat in moderate conditions.
